description: This file defines the KeyspacesClient class used to interact with the Amazon Keyspaces service via AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations for various operations such as creating, deleting, and listing keyspaces, tables, and types.

classes.name: KeyspacesClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with Amazon Keyspaces, extending the generic AwsClient class.

methods.name: createKeyspace
methods.description: Creates a new Keyspace in Amazon Keyspaces.

methods.name: createTable
methods.description: Creates a new table in a Keyspace.

methods.name: createType
methods.description: Creates a new user-defined type in a Keyspace.

methods.name: createTypeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new user-defined type.

methods.name: getKeyspace
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specified Keyspace.

methods.name: getKeyspaceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves information about a Keyspace.

methods.name: getTableAutoScalingSettings
methods.description: Retrieves auto-scaling settings for a table.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Fetches details of a user-defined type.

methods.name: getTypeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches details of a user-defined type.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags for a specified resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: restoreTable
methods.description: Restores a table from a snapshot.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds tags to a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
